title: Restrained Diffusion Bridges: Targeted Denoiser Training and Refinement
abstract: arXiv:2611.02170v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Diffusion models are often inaccurate in critical, data-sparse regions of the target distribution. Sampling from restrained distributions, biased distributions used in classical enhanced sampling to concentrate data near chosen configurations, can control where training data are collected but biases the learned distribution. We establish that this bias cancels exactly when forward noising from restrained data is conditioned on the restrained configuration at an appropriately chosen intermediate time. This allows a pretrained model fine-tuned on restrained data to achieve high accuracy in any chosen region of the target distribution, regardless of its probability, using standard denoising or flow matching objectives without importance weights. When no target data are available, Gibbs sampling enables inference from a model trained exclusively on restrained data.

translated_title: 受限扩散桥：有针对性的去噪器训练与精化
translated_abstract: 扩散模型在目标分布中关键但数据稀疏的区域往往不够准确。从受限分布采样——这是经典增强采样中使用的一类有偏分布，用于将数据集中在所选构型附近——可以控制训练数据的采集位置，但会使学到的分布产生偏差。我们证明，当从受限数据出发的前向加噪过程以适当选择的中间时刻的受限构型为条件时，这种偏差会被精确抵消。这使得在受限数据上微调的预训练模型，能够在目标分布的任意选定区域（无论该区域的概率大小）实现高精度，且只需使用标准的去噪或流匹配目标函数，无需重要性权重。当目标数据不可用时，吉布斯采样使得仅用受限数据训练的模型也能进行推断。
tldr: 受限扩散桥方法通过在选定的中间时刻以受限构型为条件进行前向加噪，使受限采样引入的偏差被精确抵消，从而让模型在目标分布中任意关键的数据稀疏区域都能高精度生成，无需重要性权重。
